description: Read the owner's shared organization credit balance (available_micros is monthly plus one-time credit minus reservations) and the seven-day grace_started_at/grace_expires_at that begins when the credit is used up. It states what is left, not what the credit was spent on; read organization_usage_get for the recent charges. Existing services/domains are not immediately shut down at zero credit; an explicit project stop budget is separate. One credit is 1000000 microcredits. Provider outages are not customer debt. Works at zero credit. Top-ups and enabling auto-recharge require active Paid access.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.
